library.description: Actions you configured, ready for workflows and keys
library.emptyHint: Actions you create appear here, ready for workflows and device keys.
library.step1: Step 1 of 2: choose what the action does
library.step2: Step 2 of 2: name it and set its parameters

first.title: Create your first action
first.body: An action is one thing DeckPilot does, such as running a command or opening a URL. Choose a type from your modules, give it a name and set its parameters. Then put it on a device key or into a workflow.

noSelection.title: No action selected
noSelection.body: Choose an action on the left, or create a new one.

states.title: Title of state {{number}}
states.hint_one: Each press runs the current state and, when that run succeeds, moves to the next one; after the last it starts again. {{min}} to {{count}} state.
states.hint_other: Each press runs the current state and, when that run succeeds, moves to the next one; after the last it starts again. {{min}} to {{count}} states.

profile.missing: This profile no longer exists. Choose another one, or the key will fail.

candidates.empty: Add what the key picks from.
candidates.hint: A candidate with weight 3 is picked three times as often as one with weight 1.

failure.checkAgent: Check that the agent is running

unavailable.title: Unavailable
unavailable.pluginKept: {{reason}}. The action is kept; it can be edited and run again once the plugin can run (Settings › Plugins).
unavailable.moduleDisabled: The {{module}} module is disabled. Enable it in Settings to edit or run this action; it is kept until then.
unavailable.noModule: No installed module provides “{{type}}”. The action is kept but cannot run.

editor.legacy: Deprecated type: {{module}} moved to the plugin {{plugin}}, which runs it as <target>{{target}}</target>. Your action keeps working; new actions use the plugin's type.
editor.name: Name
editor.projectPlaceholders: Use {{key}} or {{name}} to show the active project on the key.

modifies.title: This action changes things
modifies.body: Running it changes state on this computer or elsewhere (for example a command, a request or containers). Some modules only allow that after it is turned on in their settings on each computer.

editor.runHint: Runs in the agent for the active profile
editor.deleteHint: To delete the action, choose for each reference whether it uses another action or is unbound.

references.notUsed: Not used in any workflow or layout.
references.label: References

failure.changesKept: The changes made before were kept; close this dialog to see the current references

references.clearedSettings_one: Parameter overrides and mappings were removed from {{count}} step or node: the replacement is another action type.
references.clearedSettings_other: Parameter overrides and mappings were removed from {{count}} steps or nodes: the replacement is another action type.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.unused: The action is removed from this profile. This cannot be undone.
delete.used_one: The action is used in {{count}} place. Choose for each whether it uses another action instead or is unbound; then the action is deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.used_other: The action is used in {{count}} places. Choose for each whether it uses another action instead or is unbound; then the action is deleted. This cannot be undone.

references.unbindHint: Unbind leaves the key empty or removes the step from its workflow. A graph node cannot be unbound: replace it, or open the workflow editor and remove it there.
references.triggersHint: Triggers follow their workflow: they run whatever the workflow runs after the change.

none.title: No action types available
none.body: Action types come from modules. Enable a module to create actions.

project.none: This profile has no projects yet. Add one on the Projects page.
project.notInProfile: The saved project is not part of this profile. Choose one of its projects.

pairs.secret: {{name}} holds a secret and cannot be saved here. Use a stored credential instead.

credential.noneStored: No credentials are stored on this computer. Add them in Settings › HTTP.
credential.missing: “{{name}}” is not stored on this computer; requests fail until it is added in Settings › HTTP.

execution.openToSee: Open the workflow to see which step failed.

requireProfile.title: No profile yet
requireProfile.body: Profiles hold your actions, workflows, projects and layouts.
